samples.marker: Ded VPN 2.2.7: neutral proxy and startup-storage observations
evidence: Manifest identifies Ded VPN 2.2.7, MV3, permissions proxy and storage only. Both JavaScript members are unobfuscated and were read in full.
Popup click sends G083_SET with the requested enabled Boolean. lockPill applies the fixed HTTPS proxy only for enabled=true, clears it for false, and saves the resulting preference.

Startup restores the saved Boolean, which defaults to false. Installation opens the provider site, and the Premium button opens the same site. No content script, request interception, remote script evaluation, or sensitive-data collection was found.

samples.marker: Beacon status helper: narrow process and network POST findings
evidence: post(m) UTF8-encodes its argument, sets WebRequest.Method=POST and writes those bytes to the request stream at the configured external IP /ic endpoint.

The four-iteration loop checks process 6364 and captures netstat rows for a named C2 connection every eight seconds. The joined report also contains a WMIC command-line/executable-path query and filtered external established connections.

The script calls post with the joined report. Its own beacon-host, C2, and sql/stager-session report fields identify an intrusion-status collection purpose. This source-to-send path supports the manual malicious judgment, independently of sandbox score.

Generic Get-Process, netstat, and POST co-occurrence does not by itself establish unauthorized exfiltration. Replacement rules are suspicious and explicitly describe beacon-caption/query/POST co-occurrence rather than claiming proven data flow.

samples.marker: Synthetic .NET RAT: correct claims; add critical-process coverage
evidence: CLR entry token 0x06000039, Program.Main RVA 0x2908 calls the surveillance, credential collection, persistence, propagation and impact routines. Namespace NanoCoreFinal and planted family labels do not establish genuine NanoCore lineage.

KeyloggerModule.Start RVA 0x20cc installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL=13. HookCallback RVA 0x21dc records keys, active-window title and time; SendLoop RVA 0x22e8 appends plaintext to ProgramData/WindowsUpdate/keylog.txt and attempts to send KEYLOG records.

Main writes HKCU Run values, a Startup batch file, and a logon scheduled task; writes ms-settings shell open command plus empty DelegateExecute then launches fodhelper; launches Defender-disabling commands and attempts creation of a local administrator account.

Clipboard loop RVA 0x355c reads changed clipboard text, screenshot loop RVA 0x36b0 captures/JPEG-encodes the screen, PasswordRecoveryModule worker RVA 0x26ec sends browser stores, and ReadBrowserData RVA 0x4bec copies browser databases to a staging directory.

Reverse-shell worker RVA 0x3b88 creates a TcpClient and hidden cmd.exe with redirected streams. Paired relay methods RVA 0x3b10 and 0x3b4c explicitly bridge peer input to stdin and stdout to peer output.

SendToC2 RVA 0x42b4 XORs UTF8 bytes with the repeating 32-byte key initialized as index XOR 0xaa, Base64-encodes the result and constructs a GET /log?d= URL. Config.C2_DOMAIN already contains http://, so URL construction doubles the scheme and TCP receives a scheme-bearing hostname; successful intended external communication is not established.

RealEncryption worker RVA 0x4718 targets Desktop/TestFolder, reads files, configures AES, writes suffixed output then deletes the original. Static key is 17 bytes and IV 15 bytes; these are invalid AES sizes. The existing attempted-replacement description is retained; no claim of successful file encryption is made.

DeleteShadowCopies RVA 0x494c launches vssadmin and WMIC deletion commands. USB worker RVA 0x4438 copies the image to ready removable drives, hides it, and writes executable AutoRun content. Ransom notes and wallpaper changes are separate local effects.

Main IL offsets 0x580..0x597 set a true integer local and call NtSetInformationProcess(current-process handle, 29, ref flag, 4). Added a neutral probable termination-critical call layout, without claiming the API succeeded.

The method called ProcessHollowing at RVA 0x3258 only allocates/writes six bytes 31 c0 83 c0 64 c3 into notepad and starts a remote thread. This is injection mechanics with a return-100 stub, not image replacement, AMSI patching or ETW patching. Those TECHNIQUE labels do not establish those attacks.
